text: An 8-word text prompt now produces a chart-quality, 3-minute vocal track in under 90 seconds.
Suno launched its v3 model in March 2024. Udio followed in April.
Both tools work the same way: type a phrase— "upbeat funk with male vocals"— hit generate, and receive a finished song with drums, bass, guitar, and lead vocal, fully mixed and mastered.
The file is immediately distributable to Spotify, Apple Music, and TikTok without opening a DAW.
But in June 2024, Universal, Sony, and Warner filed suit against both companies, alleging unlicensed training
on copyrighted recordings. The suits are still active. The tools kept shipping. By 2025, Suno's free mobile tier
gives any user 10 songs a day. A union studio session in Los Angeles runs a 3-hour
minimum at AFM scale over $450 in musician fees before a single note is tracked.
